policy-inquiry.legacy: java-facade serves policy and coverage inquiry
policy-inquiry.new: pas-policy-service serves policy and coverage inquiry

renewal.new: pas-policy-service POST /api/v1/policies/{n}/renewals (policy:renew); shadow writes pas_shadow.renewal_results only

endorsement.new: pas-policy-service POST /api/v1/policies/{n}/endorsements (policy:endorse); shadow writes pas_shadow.endorsement_results only

premium-batch.new: pas-batch calculates premiums in pas; shadow writes to pas_shadow

daily-extract.legacy: mainframe job creates the daily claims extract
daily-extract.new: pas-batch creates the daily claims extract

monthly-exposure.legacy: mainframe job creates the monthly actuarial exposure
monthly-exposure.new: pas-batch creates the monthly actuarial exposure

document-events.legacy: legacy PAS document events are delivered through the mainframe
document-events.new: Kafka document/referral events bridged to legacy MQ queues by pas-policy-service (IBM037 POLICY-RECORD)
document-events.precondition: Keep legacy until bridge consumers, operations, and owners sign off; non-local/test deployments require an MQ TLS cipher suite before setting new; retire only after the queue-decommission preconditions are met.

broker-portal-read.legacy: Broker Portal reads through the legacy linked server
broker-portal-read.new: Broker Portal uses GET /api/v1/policies list/get/coverages; no DB2 connection
broker-portal-read.precondition: Keep legacy until portal-team acceptance and entitlement, masking, and operational sign-off are recorded; broker-portal-read cannot be shadow or new unless policy-inquiry serves traffic.
